## Overview

The IMEKO World Congress is a broad measurement science conference covering multiple metrology domains. While not emissivity-specific, it serves as an umbrella meeting where thermometry, radiation measurement, and related metrological topics may be represented among wider measurement science tracks.


::: {.callout-note}
Not emissivity-specific; included as a broad metrology venue where relevant sessions may occur.
